The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was created:

**Project: `RecipeCommunity`** (Blazor Web App with Interactive Server mode)

**Structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — Recipe and RecipeSubmission models
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — In-memory recipe store with 8 sample recipes
- `Components/Pages/Home.razor` — Homepage with category cards (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Recipes/Category.razor` — Browse recipes by category (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Recipes/Detail.razor` — Recipe detail with ingredients & steps (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Recipes/StarRating.razor` — Interactive 1–5 star rating widget (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)
- `Components/Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — Interactive recipe submission form (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)

**Key design decisions:**
- Most pages render as static SSR (read-only content)
- Only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `InteractiveServer` — minimal SignalR usage
- Categories: breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts
- Run with `dotnet run --project RecipeCommunity`
